blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio on Wednesday said a special committee that drafted proposed amendments to the spending bill violated an internal parliamentary rule when it failed to issue a detailed budget tweak report, as the House of Representatives began second reading consideration on the 2027 spending measure. Tinio sought clarification from the House floor regarding the proposed realignments by the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc), which last week met to settle potential changes to the P7.2-trillion budget bill. “We are already in the period of amendments, and yet there is still, as far as I know, no […]...
